notes: PERFORMANCE: no more hitch at the start of every match. The replay's map picture used to resize the whole game canvas, and could leave the game drawing more pixels than your screen has. It now uses its own small picture, made once per map.
PERFORMANCE: the shaders for explosions, blood, sparks, smoke and ragdolls are compiled during the loading screen, so the first fight of a match no longer stutters.
PERFORMANCE: maps with lots of lamps (DISPENSARY ROW, the night maps) keep only the 8 most important lights near you, and redraw shadows every other frame, like zombies already did.
PERFORMANCE: with BLOOM & COLOUR on, the screen no longer runs a second, wasted anti-aliasing pass (applies on next launch). Menus draw at most 60 frames a second.
Still in from 1.2.70: ONLINE LAST TOKE and the online PROP HUNT fix.
